dispute_ticket.description: The driver took a long detour and the trip was 31 minutes instead of 18. He never asked me and never told me why. I want some of the fare back.

chat_logs.content: Bukit Timah Rd is closed ahead, I'll go via Dunearn Rd instead. OK?

app_events.details: Closure of Bukit Timah Rd (Newton to Clemenceau) verified from traffic feed, active 20:00 to 23:00.
Navigation rerouted via Dunearn Rd due to verified closure.
Fare S$16.50 charged (fixed upfront; equal to quote).

fare_basis.text: States how this trip's fare is set: a fixed upfront price, or a metered fare that varies with distance and time.

detour_for_verified_road_closure_billabl.text: Governs extra distance caused by a road closure. A true value means the rider may be billed for it only when the closure is verified.

rider_route_requests_must_be_agreed_befo.text: Binds the rider. A route or stop that the rider asks for must be agreed with the driver before the trip starts. It does not govern route changes the driver makes.

expected_outcome.reason: The 1.8 km extra distance (9.0 km driven vs 7.2 km planned) came from a road closure that the platform verified at 20:49:30 (Bukit Timah Rd, active 20:00-23:00), and the navigation reroute at 20:51:00 follows it. The chat also contradicts the rider's 'never asked': the driver asked at 20:52:10 and the rider answered 'ok' at 20:52:40. The fare was fixed upfront at S$16.50 and charged at S$16.50, so no extra distance was billed. Nothing is refundable.
